caption: The drawing depicts an object composed of a carved brown feather, vertically oriented with a tapering, rounded tip at the bottom and a slightly wider top. A flower with rounded petals is situated at the top of the feather where it widens, rendered in similar brown tones. Perched atop this flower is a bird figure, also brown, with its body angled to the left, its right wing folded against its side, and its head turned slightly downward with a visible eye and pointed beak. The feathers, the flower, and the bird are all illustrated with fine lines and shading to suggest texture and depth. The composition is centered on a plain, beige background with the name "W. W. Jennings" printed in small text at the bottom right.
title: Envelope Opener
